Callout.Name: Assault on Staff
Callout.Message: Officer assaulted during a cell move.
Callout.Advisory: Inmate restrained, officer with a head injury.

Script.Line: He came at me the moment I opened the hatch. Nothing led up to it.
He is restrained and he is not injured. I am the one bleeding.
I want this recorded. I want all of it recorded properly.

Lines.Approach: He is restrained now but the officer took one to the head. Ambulance is coming.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
